snippet.title: Mini Mart Survivors | Survive the Night Shift
snippet.description:
The night shift at SHIFT24 pays a little too well. Once the nightmare customers start pouring in, you'll see why.

Fight back with cup noodles and iced coffee, then pair your weapons with the right items to evolve them. Survive 10 minutes and the final boss shows up. Spend your pay on weapons for the next shift or put it toward your debt.

Play Mini Mart Survivors on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4916560/Mini_Mart_Survivors/
